claims.claim_ar: توصيف العلماء بـ«أحبارهم» وذكرهم ضمن من اتُخذوا أربابًا يوحي بكنية/مجاز: تحويل لقب العلماء إلى مقام ربوبية (تأثيم التقديس الموجه للبشر بدلاً من الله).
claims.claim_en: The term 'aHbaraHum' (their ahbar/leaders) and its listing among those taken as 'lords' functions as kinayah/majaz — a figurative deification: the title for scholars is used to imply a lordly/divine status (criticizing the misplaced veneration of humans instead of God).
claims.needs_review_reason: The provided chunk (I'rab entry) defines 'أحبار' but classical rhetorical commentaries (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, etc.) are not in the sources; the move from lexical definition to calling this a metaphoric 'deification' is interpretive and should be checked against tafsir/بلاغة sources.

claims.claim_ar: ذِكْرُ «رهبانهم» إلى جانب «أحبارهم» وكونهم ممن اتُّخذوا أربابًا يحمل طابعًا مجازيًا؛ أي تشبيه/تكييف للرهبان بمقام الربوبية (انتقاد تقديس الزهد البشري وتحويله إلى عبادة).
claims.claim_en: The phrase 'ruhbaanahum' (their monks) alongside 'ahbar' being taken as 'lords' carries a metaphorical/kinayah force: portraying monks as occupying a lordly/divine status (criticizing the sanctification of ascetics as objects of worship).
claims.needs_review_reason: The source chunk gives lexical notes on 'رهبان' but not rhetorical analysis; classifying the wording as deifying/metaphorical should be corroborated with classical balagha/tafsir sources.

claims.claim_ar: بناء «ما ... إلا» في سياق الآية (مقابل: «وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا…») يعبر عن أسلوب التقييد/الحصر: تأكيد أن مقصد النواميس الدينية هو عبادة إله واحد، واستدراك أن المحصل خلاف ذلك (التعدد في العبادة) خروج عن المقصود.
claims.claim_en: The 'ma ... illa' construction functions as hasr/qasr (restrictive/exclusive device): it emphasizes that the command was restricted to worshipping one God — highlighting the exclusivity of the intended purpose and implying the deviation represented by taking others as lords.
claims.needs_review_reason: The illustrative substring is taken from the provided I'rab chunk (uses 'إِلَّا' in a comparable restrictive sense). Still, verifying the Qur'anic syntactic-pragmatic force with classical rhetoricians (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, etc.) is advisable.
